FULL TEXT:
Panjab University Constituent College Sikhwala
Distt. Sri Muktsar Sahib (Punjab India) -152113
Walk-in-Interview
Walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the subject 01 Commerce & 01
Mathematics for teaching B.A. classes for the session 2024-25 will be held on 30/07/2024 in the
Committee Room at Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The eligible candidate are requested to report in the in the Committee Room at Rajiv Gandhi
College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh at 11:30 a.m. sharp on 30/07/2024. No candidate
will be considered after the stipulated time. Interview will be started at 12:00 noon sharp.
Qualifications: As per Panjab University/UGC norms.
All the applicants (Who are eligible as per UGC/PU norms are advised to bring their original
certificates and other relevant documents including publications with photo copies of certificates
and 02 passport photographs) for verification along with duly filled forms giving the details at the
time of interview. Application form will be given at the time of interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Prof. Baljinder Kaur
Principal
